watchOS 27.2 is set to launch next month with new Apple Watch features, and leaker pdfu has discovered a major change coming to screenshots.

New screenshot experience in watchOS 27.2 code borrows from iPhone

Leaker pdfu has been sharing multiple details discovered from Apple's code recently. For example, he was the first to discover the "Readiness" app in watchOS 27, and yesterday also revealed the HomePod Siri AI interface.

In a new post today, pdfu revealed that the watchOS 27.2 beta contains code for a redesigned screenshot experience on Apple Watch.

Currently, taking a screenshot on Apple Watch simply causes the screen to flash, after which the screenshot is saved to your Photos library.

The new screenshot flow mimics the current approach on iPhone and iPad, letting you instantly choose to share or delete the screenshot.

It remains unclear which watchOS 27.2 beta Apple plans to add this change to, or whether it will need more time in development. However, even if it doesn't make it into watchOS 27.2, we will very likely see this feature arrive on Apple Watch in the near future.

What do you think of the new screenshot experience leaked for watchOS 27.2? Let us know in the comments.
